question: Does the frozen-head historical reconciliation provide enough immutable evidence to make this verifier authoritative for the release?
rationale: The patch changes publication accounting and intentionally fails closed; focused tests and scoped checks cannot establish that every real historical commit, PR association, exclusion, and changelog-tail boundary reconciles correctly.

options.title: Require immutable replay
options.body: Keep the draft on hold until the frozen head produces the expected complete reconciliation and final release-candidate output.

options.title: Accept modeled proof
options.body: Proceed using the fixture suites and scoped Testbox checks without completing the real historical replay.

recommendation.title: Require immutable replay
recommendation.body: Keep the draft on hold until the frozen head produces the expected complete reconciliation and final release-candidate output.
